body.p: A fox and a bear met. The bear said: "Fox, what do you hunt?" "Wild birds! What do you eat?" "Cowberries, pine cones!" "Where do you sleep?" "I sleep inside! Where do you sleep?" "I sleep by a tree stump, I eat the wild birds in my tree." "Oh, I am scared of wild birds." "I am scared of tree stumps with crossed eyes." "Oh, how many cross-eyed ones I have killed." "You look for a cross-eyed tree stump, I will kill wild birds." They walked away. The bear started searching when he met a tree stump with ears. "Bear", the tree stump with ears said, "where are you going?" The bear said: " I will take you away." The tree stump shot the bear, flayed its fur, cut its fur, hung its nose from a tree with the bear skull. He scattered the fur outside. The human fell asleep. In the morning he got up, the fur had become a reindeer. The bear could not come to the fox. The fox waited for him, waited, went to search for him. He found the bear's head in the tree with the bear skull.
